facts.text: I am looking for information on company policies regarding diversity and inclusion.
I am particularly interested in the diversity and inclusion reports.
Women occupy 20 of the leadership positions in my company.
I recently attended a workshop on gender equality.
I want to compare my company's gender ratio to industry benchmarks.
I want to know whether the report covers data on employee resource groups such as women's networks or LGBTQ+ groups.
I want to know whether the report covers data on employee feedback and sentiment such as results from employee engagement surveys or focus groups.
I want to know whether the report would provide insights into how employees perceive the company's diversity and inclusion efforts.
I want to know whether the report covers data on diversity and inclusion training and education programs such as unconscious bias training or allyship workshops.
I want to know whether the report discusses the company's strategy for increasing diversity in hiring such as blind hiring practices or diversity-focused recruitment initiatives.
I want to know whether the report covers data on the diversity of new hires such as the percentage of women or underrepresented groups in recent hiring cohorts.
